# Vendored browser libraries

Kept in the repository so that the interface works offline and nothing is loaded from a CDN.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx | 2.0.4 | 0BSD |
| `alpine.min.js` | Alpine.js | 3.14.8 | MIT |
| `chart.umd.js` | Chart.js | 4.4.7 | MIT |

Downloaded from the jsDelivr copies of the npm packages `htmx.org`, `alpinejs` (`dist/cdn.min.js`) and `chart.js` (`dist/chart.umd.js`).
